scripts.test: docker run -v $PWD:/tests -w /tests -e BASE_URL=$BASE_URL --rm -it --ipc=host mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.23.1 yarn run playwright test
scripts.test:localhost: docker run -v $PWD:/tests -w /tests -e BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000 -e HEADLESS=true --rm -it --ipc=host --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway --network=host mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.23.1 yarn run playwright test
